content.text: Reproduced. The default Hugging Face response lists all 18 FactoryBench files but omits every size, so our adapter converts each to size `0` and the integrity gate rejects them. With `blobs=true`, the same immutable revision includes real sizes and LFS SHA-256 values. I’m verifying that behavior against Hugging Face’s official client contract, then I’ll add a regression test before changing the adapter.

content.text:
Fixed in commit `ffe13bb`.

Cause: Hugging Face omits file sizes unless `blobs=true`; our adapter interpreted missing sizes as zero.

FactoryBench now verifies live with:

- 18 files, 5.22 GB
- 7 downloadable data assets
- Time-series identity accepted
- Revision pinned to `2561c2c…`

All 105 sourcing tests pass; touched files pass Ruff. Implementation follows Hugging Face’s [file metadata contract](https://huggingface.co/docs/huggingface_hub/package_reference/hf_api#huggingface_hub.HfApi.dataset_info). Branch remains unpushed.
